admission.justification: Prevents treating fluent or short prose as proof of preserved meaning and silently dropping an actor, condition or exclusion.

applicability: Curator-authored invariant statements, family guarantees, history reasons and proposed rewrites governed by the shared writing profile.
conditions: Keep the actor, action, object, applicability, conditions, exclusions, modal force, evidence identity and frozen history.
Independent facet/case review precedes ordinary writer publication of a claimed same-meaning rewrite.
exclusions: No word-count, fluency or style heuristic establishes semantic equivalence or grants mutation authority.
This guide does not assert full ASD-STE100 conformance or rewrite historical witnesses.
statement: Curators use one STE-inspired profile that preserves actors, scope, conditions and exclusions without letting writing heuristics judge semantic equivalence.
